q: 查找名为 process_order 的函数
ngql: MATCH (n:CodeEntity) WHERE n.CodeEntity.name == "process_order" RETURN n.CodeEntity.name AS name, n.CodeEntity.filePath AS file_path

q: 查找名为 validate_input 的函数的文件路径
ngql: MATCH (n:CodeEntity) WHERE n.CodeEntity.name == "validate_input" RETURN n.CodeEntity.filePath AS file_path

q: 查找所有 function 类型的 CodeEntity
ngql: MATCH (n:CodeEntity) WHERE n.CodeEntity.entityType == "function" RETURN n.CodeEntity.name AS name, n.CodeEntity.filePath AS file_path

q: 查找 docstring 包含 database 的函数
ngql: MATCH (n:CodeEntity) WHERE n.CodeEntity.docstring CONTAINS "database" AND n.CodeEntity.entityType == "function" RETURN n.CodeEntity.name AS name, n.CodeEntity.filePath AS file_path, n.CodeEntity.docstring AS docstring LIMIT

q: 查找名为 订单处理 的概念实体
ngql: MATCH (n:ConceptEntity) WHERE n.ConceptEntity.name == "订单处理" RETURN n.ConceptEntity.name AS name, n.ConceptEntity.description AS description, n.ConceptEntity.category AS category

q: 查找 process_order 调用了哪些函数（3跳内）
ngql: MATCH (n)-[:CALLS*1..3]->(callee) WHERE n.CodeEntity.name == "process_order" RETURN callee.CodeEntity.name AS callee_name

q: 查找谁调用了 save_to_db（反向1跳）
ngql: MATCH (caller:CodeEntity)-[:CALLS]->(callee:CodeEntity) WHERE callee.CodeEntity.name == "save_to_db" RETURN caller.CodeEntity.name AS caller_name

q: 查找 process_order 到 send_notification 的调用链
查找 process_order 的所有下游函数（不限跳数，上限10）
查找所有 CALLS 关系，返回调用者和被调用者的名字
ngql: MATCH (a:CodeEntity)-[r:CALLS]->(b:CodeEntity) RETURN a.CodeEntity.name AS caller, b.CodeEntity.name AS callee

q: 查找 DESCRIBES 关系连接的代码和概念
ngql: MATCH (c:CodeEntity)-[:DESCRIBES]->(con:ConceptEntity) RETURN c.CodeEntity.name AS code, con.ConceptEntity.name AS concept

q: 查找所有处理了 DataAsset 的代码
ngql: MATCH (c:CodeEntity)-[:PROCESSES_DATA]->(d:DataAsset) RETURN c.CodeEntity.name AS code_name, c.CodeEntity.filePath AS file_path

q: 查找处理了客户订单数据的代码，以及该数据受哪些合规条款约束
ngql: MATCH (c:CodeEntity)-[:PROCESSES_DATA]->(d:DataAsset)-[:GOVERNED_BY]->(ci:ComplianceItem) WHERE d.DataAsset.name == "客户订单数据" RETURN c.CodeEntity.name AS code, d.DataAsset.name AS data, ci.ComplianceItem.name AS compliance

q: 查找 process_order 描述了哪些概念
ngql: MATCH (n:CodeEntity)-[:DESCRIBES]->(c:ConceptEntity) WHERE n.CodeEntity.name == "process_order" RETURN c.ConceptEntity.name AS concept_name, c.ConceptEntity.description AS description

q: 查找所有 ComplianceItem 以及约束的数据资产
统计每种实体类型有多少个节点
统计有多少条 CALLS 边
查找每个 CodeEntity 调用了多少个其他函数
ngql: MATCH (c:CodeEntity)-[:CALLS]->(called:CodeEntity) RETURN c.CodeEntity.name AS caller_name, count(DISTINCT called) AS call_count

q: 查找同时描述了概念且处理了数据的代码
ngql: MATCH (c:CodeEntity)-[:DESCRIBES]->(:ConceptEntity), (c)-[:PROCESSES_DATA]->(:DataAsset) RETURN c.CodeEntity.name AS name, c.CodeEntity.filePath AS file_path
